Bed levelling point 0: an M4 x 40 countersunk screw from the bed's top face (head 0.7 mm below it, under the magnetic base) is locked to the plate by a washer and nut underneath, so it is a fixed stud. A die spring (DJ-8X20YCS, 7.6 N/mm, compressed 8 mm: 61 N) between that nut and the deck pushes the bed up; the stud passes the deck through a fitted 4.3 mm hole (this stud, front left, locates the bed) and a large washer and knurled thumb nut under the deck hold it down. Turn the thumb nut to level: 0.7 mm per turn, +/-1.5 mm. Three points: they set the bed's plane and cannot twist the plate.
